issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This indicates a scroll-related component (likely a parallax, scroll indicator, or intersection observer component) has a statically-positioned container.
issues.element: Scroll indicator or parallax container component
issues.root_cause: A component using scroll offset calculation (possibly the 'See how it works ↓ SCROLL' element, a parallax hero, or a scroll progress indicator) is mounted inside a container with default 'position: static'. The library or custom hook computing scroll offset requires a positioned ancestor.

issues.description: Background color cannot be fully verified as exactly #091829 from screenshot due to the hero image overlay, but the visible dark tone appears consistent with the spec. No definitive failure but worth a CSS audit.
issues.root_cause: The background image overlay may be masking the actual background-color value, making visual verification ambiguous. If the image fails to load in production, the fallback color must be #091829.

fixes.reason: Adds a non-static position to the scroll indicator container so that scroll offset is calculated correctly, resolving the console warning.
Alternative fix if the warning originates from the hero section's scroll wrapper rather than a dedicated ScrollIndicator component.
Ensures the body fallback background is explicitly set to #091829 as specified, so if the hero image fails to load the correct dark navy color is shown.
